response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior engineer with deep open-source and Linux experience, but he falls short on two hard requirements: German proficiency (basic vs. required C1) and a proven track record of leading and managing teams at an executive level. His background is predominantly hands-on individual contribution rather than operational leadership, client advisory, or formal architecture governance, making him a poor fit for a Head of Development role in a German-speaking consulting context.
strengths: 18+ years of broad software development experience across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems
Genuine open-source commitment (founder of GISCollective, multiple D-language libraries) and strong Linux background
Demonstrated mentoring/knowledge-sharing through workshops, courses, and conference talks
concerns: German language is only basic; the role requires minimum C1
No formal team leadership, people management, or executive-level responsibility in employment history
No evidence of UML expertise, Python proficiency, or formal requirements/risk/compliance management

key_factors.factor: Strong open-source and Linux engineering depth
